measures.title: 2026 HTS Revision 21
measures.description: USITC published Revision 21 on October 9, 2026. The revision is an official tariff schedule source, not a ready-made HTS-to-additional-duty mapping.

measures.title: Section 301 — 2026 actions
measures.description: The 2026 HTS archive identifies July Section 301 actions and conforming changes. Country, HTS coverage, exclusions and legal stacking require rule-level extraction and review.

measures.title: Section 232 — pharmaceuticals
measures.description: The September 28 revision identifies pharmaceutical tariff adjustments. Product, company, country, exemption and timing conditions are not yet modeled.

measures.title: Section 232 — unmanned aircraft
measures.description: The September 2 revision identifies unmanned aircraft systems and component adjustments. Product classification and Chapter 99 mappings remain to be validated.

measures.title: Section 232 — metals and derivatives
measures.description: The 2026 archive lists changes to aluminum, steel and copper measures. Content-based valuation, derivative scope and legal interactions remain unmodeled.

measures.title: IEEPA historical treatment
measures.description: IEEPA duty collection ceased for entries from February 24, 2026 according to contemporaneous CBP reporting. Historical cases remain separate from current payable rules.
